measurement_note: Received counters include drain time; throughput/goodput denominator is app_stop_s-app_start_s. Unreceived packets may still be queued if drain is insufficient. Delay/jitter are IP-level for received packets. No UL SINR is reported from DL traces.

metric_definitions.actual_offered_load_mbps: Payload bytes accepted by the UDP socket (application Tx trace) * 8 / full application window / 1e6, including OFF periods.
metric_definitions.end_to_end_delay_ms: Mean IP-level delay from UE transmission to cloud reception, for received packets.
metric_definitions.jitter_ms: FlowMonitor sum of absolute consecutive packet delay differences / (received packets - 1), in ms.
metric_definitions.loss_fraction: (Transmitted packets - received packets) / transmitted packets after drain; may include packets still queued.
metric_definitions.throughput_mbps: Received IP bytes * 8 / application window / 1e6; includes IP/UDP headers and packets received during drain.
metric_definitions.undefined_metrics: null when there are insufficient packets or no matching flow.

scenario.antenna_gain_implementation: Reciprocal scalar gNB cosine gain chained after Friis; UE gain 0 dBi.
scenario.harq_configuration_note: EnableHarqReTx selects a retransmission limit of 0 or 3 in this NR version; initial transmission excluded. Disabling retransmissions does not remove all HARQ feedback or buffering.
scenario.harq_processes_note: NumHarqProcess is configured equally at gNB and UE MAC. This NR version also uses it in HARQ timer handling. The scenario accepts 2..16; one process is excluded after an inactive-process feedback fatal error in execution 175. Values 2, 4, 8 and 16 completed the TdmaRR study.
scenario.link_condition_basis: Assumed unobstructed free-space link; no LOS/NLOS condition model is installed.
scenario.nr_panel_configuration: 1x1 isotropic at UE and gNB; gNB pattern applied separately in propagation chain
scenario.packet_interval_note: For CBR, packet_interval_us takes precedence over dataRate. On/Off requires dataRate without packet_interval_us. Rate is rounded to integer bps. Reported interval is nominal from payload size and configured rate, not measured Tx spacing; event scheduling is subject to simulator time resolution. Changing interval at fixed payload size also changes offered load.
scenario.rlc_configuration_note: Configured RRC data-bearer mapping and equal MaxTxBufferSize defaults for UM and AM. AM limit covers its new-data Txon buffer, not total RLC memory. Other RLC attributes retain their installed defaults.
scenario.scheduler_configuration_note: Default scheduler attributes and existing bearer/LC configuration.
scenario.traffic_model_note: OnOff starts in OFF. Constant durations are fixed; exponential durations are independent, unbounded draws with configured means. DataRate and nominal packet interval describe the ON state. Nominal mean load = ON rate * mean ON/(mean ON + mean OFF); this is a long-run target, not the expected exact load of a finite run. Actual load is measured using successful application Tx events. Residual packet bits persist across ON periods. This is not a Poisson source.
